title: Evidence-Class + Claim Satisfaction Gate

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: concrete engineering modules/contracts/proofs/protocols with Self-Improvement

source_provenance.notes: Human Evidence Firewall, Evidence Family Law and Proof Ledger explicitly require evidence classes and block cross-class substitution
Concrete domain evidence: provider, machine, human and promotion stages must remain separate

source_provenance.locator: PR #105 Book Engine Milestone F DISCOVERY_ONLY bridge
source_provenance.notes: Project sensors submit typed evidence, not global authority or literary superiority

problem_or_opportunity: As engineering coverage increases, machine tests, AI reviews, source hashes, provider artifacts, human listens, specialist reviews, market results and Founder decisions can be accidentally conflated into a generic 'verified' label.
proposed_mechanism: Represent evidence with explicit orthogonal class and root provenance family; represent claims with required evidence classes and optional minimum independent families; fail closed on missing class, cross-class impersonation or pseudo-independence; never authorize promotion/lock merely because a claim packet passes.
expected_benefit: Prevents evidence inflation, false human/provider/market claims, accidental Founder-lock inference and model-report-count pseudo-replication.

promotion_requirements: cross-domain pilot on book + audio claim packets
real human/provider/specialist/market classes only when actually observed

pilot_evidence: Local deterministic anti-inflation smoke: AI review cannot satisfy HUMAN_SIGNAL
Negative regression suite covers machine/provider, provenance/market, story-machine/specialist, pseudo-independent provenance families, Founder authority
Positive fixture requires exact requested class and independent families
red_team_findings: An evidence gate can verify class satisfaction but cannot itself grant authority
Evidence independence follows root provenance, not report/model count
Prepared human-listener packet is not HUMAN_SIGNAL until actually performed
Unknown spend/time/duration must remain null rather than zero
next_action: Compile representative book/audio/system claim packets and run class-gate regression; attach output to proof ledger without inferring promotion.
hold_trigger: Any requested substitution between evidence classes without an explicit controlling contract.
